core/shell@1.0.0.name: shell
core/shell@1.0.0.summary: App frame with sidebar, header and main regions.

agent.use: Root block of any multi-region artifact. Put exactly one nav in `sidebar`.
agent.avoid: Nesting shells.

core/sidebar@1.2.0.name: sidebar
core/sidebar@1.2.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Primary navigation between 3–9 sections. Bind `value` to a state key and read it from content blocks with `visible`.
agent.avoid: More than 9 items; put nested content in tabs instead.

core/dropdown@1.3.0.name: dropdown
core/dropdown@1.3.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Any single choice; scales to long option lists.
agent.avoid: Two options — use a button pair.

agent.use: 2–6 sibling views inside one section.
agent.avoid: Top-level navigation (that is the sidebar's job).

agent.use: One primary per region; labels are verbs.
agent.avoid: Using a button to show state.

agent.use: Search boxes, names, short answers.
agent.avoid: Choices from a known list — use dropdown.

agent.use: Group one topic's content; header actions go in the `actions` slot.
agent.avoid: Cards inside cards.

core/stack@1.0.0.name: stack
core/stack@1.0.0.summary: Lay children out in a row, column or grid.

agent.use: All layout. `columns` switches to an even grid.
agent.avoid: Pixel values; gap is a spacing step.

core/text@1.0.0.name: text
core/text@1.0.0.summary: A run of text in one type style.

agent.use: Headings and prose. Use `$tpl` for text that reads state.
agent.avoid: Long documents; that is a Docs artifact.

agent.use: Status next to a title or row.
agent.avoid: Interactive filters.

agent.use: 3–4 KPIs in a stack with `columns`. Feed `value` with `$count`/`$sum` over data.
agent.avoid: More than 6 in a row.

core/table@1.0.0.name: table
core/table@1.0.0.summary: Rows of records under typed columns.

agent.use: Records; bind `rows` to `$filter` over a data source for interactive filtering.
agent.avoid: Over ~200 rows without paging.

core/page@1.0.0.name: page
core/page@1.0.0.summary: Sidebar-free page with optional header and footer and a reading, wide or full canvas.

agent.use: Choose freely: reading for reports, wide for landing pages, full for tools. Any block may be the root. Navigation is optional.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/section@1.0.0.name: section
core/section@1.0.0.summary: Editorial or hero region with optional title, prose, content and actions.

agent.use: Compose heroes, report chapters and feature sections; actions are ordinary blocks. Avoid adding a card around every section.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/grid@1.0.0.name: grid
core/grid@1.0.0.summary: Responsive equal-column grid that fits its container and stacks on narrow canvases.

columns.description: Maximum column count, a positive integer. Fewer columns render when needed to fit the canvas.

agent.use: Use for galleries, feature cards and dashboards; columns is the maximum, minSize controls when columns fit. Children remain in source order.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/split@1.0.0.name: split
core/split@1.0.0.summary: Two flowing panes with a chosen ratio, stacked in source order on narrow canvases.

agent.use: Use for side-by-side explanation and interaction, image and prose, or input and output. Does not create a sidebar.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/image@1.0.0.name: image
core/image@1.0.0.summary: Accessible image with a semantic aspect ratio, fit and optional caption.

agent.use: Use HTTPS URLs, local / paths or raster data URLs. Provide descriptive alt text; use empty alt only for decoration.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/code@1.0.0.name: code
core/code@1.0.0.summary: Literal source code or structured text; displayed, never executed.

agent.use: Display examples, JSON, logs or source. Content remains literal text even when it contains markup.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

agent.use: Use for instructions, summaries and checklists; items are text, ordered enables numbered steps.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/divider@1.0.0.name: divider
core/divider@1.0.0.summary: Semantic separator between flowing content regions.

agent.use: Separate adjacent topics without wrapping them in cards.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

core/textarea@1.0.0.name: textarea
core/textarea@1.0.0.summary: Labelled multiline input with public value and change events.

agent.use: Use for notes, drafts and longer answers. Read value or bind it to declared state; change emits {value}.

a11y.keyboard: Native multiline text input: Tab to focus, typing to edit.

core/slider@1.0.0.name: slider
core/slider@1.0.0.summary: Labelled numeric range input with a live value.

agent.use: Use for numeric exploration and simulations; change emits {value}. Native arrow keys adjust by step.

core/checkbox@1.0.0.name: checkbox
core/checkbox@1.0.0.summary: Labelled boolean choice with public checked state.

agent.use: Use for independent options; change emits {checked}. Space toggles the native checkbox.

core/bar-chart@1.0.0.name: bar-chart
core/bar-chart@1.0.0.summary: Responsive horizontal bars with accessible labels and numeric values.

agent.use: Use for comparisons; bind items to data or $map. Values stay visible to assistive technology, including negative values.

a11y.keyboard: Semantic content; interactive children own their keyboard behavior.

ledger/sidebar@2.0.0.name: sidebar
ledger/sidebar@2.0.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Grouped nav: set `group` on items for section headers, `code` for 2–4 char tickers.
agent.avoid: Long labels; Ledger truncates at one line.

ledger/dropdown@2.0.0.name: dropdown
ledger/dropdown@2.0.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Segmented control: every option visible, one tap. Up to 6 short options.
agent.avoid: Long or dynamic option lists — pin `core/dropdown@1` for those.

agent.use: Mono uppercase tabs; `count` renders as [n].
agent.avoid: Tab labels over 14 characters.

agent.use: `kbd` shows a keyboard hint (display only).
agent.avoid: Sentence-case labels; Ledger uppercases.

agent.use: Panels in dense grids; `code` is a short panel id like PNL-01.
agent.avoid: Padding-heavy content; bodies sit flush.

agent.use: `trend` (8–30 numbers) draws a sparkline.
agent.avoid: Decorative trends with no data.

atelier/sidebar@1.0.0.name: sidebar
atelier/sidebar@1.0.0.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

agent.use: Up to 6 items, each may carry a one-line `description`.
agent.avoid: Dense tool navigation — that is Ledger's job.

atelier/dropdown@1.0.0.name: dropdown
atelier/dropdown@1.0.0.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

agent.use: Chips that wrap; good for 2–10 friendly choices.
agent.avoid: Options over 3 words.

agent.use: Pill switcher for 2–4 views.
agent.avoid: More than 4 tabs.

agent.use: Pill buttons; primary is ink-filled.
agent.avoid: More than one primary per card.

agent.use: `eyebrow` is a short kicker above a serif title; actions sit at the bottom.
agent.avoid: Tables inside Atelier cards on narrow screens.

agent.use: Big serif figure with a sentence `caption`.
agent.avoid: More than 3 per row.
